concerns.text: FR-001 requires loading real resting‑state fMRI data with documented musical‑training history (≥1 year). The current pipeline defaults to *Synthetic Verification Mode*, generating mock rs‑fMRI and artificial training histories, which cannot provide evidence about the real‑world relationship. This violates the core scientific premise of the study.

The validation strategy injects a known group effect into the synthetic dataset and then tests for that effect. Because the outcome is constructed to match the hypothesis, the validation is circular/tautological and does not constitute an independent test of the hypothesis on real data.

FR-001 defines the musician group as having ≥1 year of training, but the implementation plan (referenced in the unresolved concerns) uses a ≥2 year threshold. This inconsistency changes the construct being measured without justification, threatening construct validity and comparability to prior literature.

The `ConnectivityMatrix` entity is specified to contain per‑subject fields (subject_id, atlas, n_rois, z_matrix, networks). The plan stores a plain 3‑D NumPy array (`connectivity_matrices.npy`) that lacks these metadata fields, violating the data model and preventing traceability of each matrix to its subject.

Constitution Principle IV (Single Source of Truth) requires every figure, statistic, or interpretation to trace back to exactly one row in `data/` and one block in `code/`. The current plan does not designate a master results artifact (e.g., a canonical CSV/JSON) as the SSoT, leaving the provenance chain ambiguous.
